top_issues.issue: Narrow Calls layout clips its primary task.
top_issues.evidence: 760x640: content starts x396; join card extends past x759 and its Join button is absent. Table explanation column starts about x741 and is cut off.
top_issues.fix: Below 1000 pt window width collapse the 300 pt people sidebar; make join card width min(680 pt, available width); stack table rows into title/status/description with 16 pt side padding.

top_issues.issue: Muted informational text repeatedly fails the 4.5:1 text requirement.
top_issues.evidence: Pillow sampled chats timestamp pixel (552,179): #8C8E96 on #FFFFFF = 3.27:1; dark (540,179): #6D6F78 on #17181B = 3.55:1. Calendar labels #8C8E96/#F6F6F7 = 3.03:1; dark #6D6F78/#1D1E22 = 3.33:1. Image dimensions and settings help #6D6F78/#25262B = 3.02:1. New-chat selected email #8C8E96/#E4E4E8 = 2.58:1; dark #6D6F78/#34353C = 2.44:1.
top_issues.fix: Use #626570 for light secondary text and #B1B4BF for dark secondary text, including selected rows. These yield 5.81:1 on white, 5.38:1 on #F6F6F7 and 5.90:1 on #34353C. Set instructions to at least 12 pt.

top_issues.issue: White text on orange primary buttons fails body-text contrast.
top_issues.evidence: Sampled new-chat label ROI x410-560,y420-432: #FFFFFF over #C26318 = 4.12:1. Same pair sampled in signin x432-610,y385-412. Labels are small body text, not large text.
top_issues.fix: Darken light primary fill to #B45309 with #FFFFFF labels, yielding 5.02:1. Preserve dark-theme dark text on orange, measured 7.24:1.

top_issues.issue: Fixed sidebar and hover action placement compromise message reading.
top_issues.evidence: 760 px screenshots: rail 64 px plus sidebar 300 px leaves x364-759 for conversation; chats hover toolbar x444-732,y267-305 crosses the sender row; channel toolbar x506-738,y333-371 crosses Hedy Lamarr heading.
top_issues.fix: At widths below 960 pt offer a collapsible 240 pt sidebar or single-pane conversation with Back. Reserve 40 pt above hovered message for toolbar; constrain it within the message gutter without covering text.

top_issues.issue: Orange small text fails contrast on white and tinted surfaces.
top_issues.evidence: Sender/shortcut pixels #C26318 on #FFFFFF = 4.12:1; mention pixel (436,381) #C26318 over #FDF1E5; DEMO pixel (17,688) #C26318 over #ECECEE. The latter surfaces further reduce contrast.
top_issues.fix: Use #9A4608 for small orange text, including names, shortcut keys, mentions and DEMO. Keep the accent tint for decorative surfaces, rather than text.

top_issues.issue: Inputs, unchecked checkboxes and focused drafts lack sufficient visual distinction.
top_issues.evidence: Chat composer top border #DFDFE3 against #FFFFFF = 1.33:1; dark #303137 against #25262B = 1.16:1. Settings unchecked checkbox center #EEEEF0 on white; dark #2C2D33 on #25262B. Long-draft screenshot shows no distinct focus ring.
top_issues.fix: Use #858995 for essential light control boundaries and #9195A1 for dark boundaries. Add a 2 pt #B45309 light / #E88C3E dark focus ring with 2 pt offset; give checkboxes a 16 pt outline and clear checkmark.

top_issues.issue: Attachment thumbnails obscure the attached images.
top_issues.evidence: Preview row x393-891,y622-718 shows tall images split/cropped at the row boundaries and panoramic content reduced to fragments. Remove marks lie around x556,738,920.
top_issues.fix: Fit each entire image inside a 96x96 pt tile using contain, with a neutral backdrop. Put a 24x24 pt remove button at each tile top-right and filename or dimensions below in 12 pt text.

top_issues.issue: Failed-send feedback is detached from a recoverable failed message.
top_issues.evidence: Toast x370-910,y638-692 covers latest conversation content. No failed-message marker or Retry control is visible in the shot.
top_issues.fix: Place a persistent 12 pt Failed to send label and Retry button below the failed message; keep the draft/message visible. Anchor optional toast above the composer with 12 pt clearance and an explicit Retry action.

top_issues.issue: Initial states give contradictory or unhelpful directions.
top_issues.evidence: Both screens repeat a chat-bubble state at sidebar center x244,y330 and main pane x852,y260. Main pane says Pick a chat on the left while sidebar is loading or has no chats.
top_issues.fix: During first sync show one main 18 pt Loading your chats heading with a 20 pt spinner and 14 pt explanation. For empty accounts replace the main instruction with a 32 pt-high Start a chat button; remove duplicate sidebar illustration.

top_issues.issue: Settings copy clips at the scrollbar and form labels scan backwards.
top_issues.evidence: Help around y442 runs to x890 directly under/against scrollbar x892-898. Open in follows its dropdown around x690,y603; Browser follows its dropdown around x521,y640.
top_issues.fix: Reserve a 16 pt scrollbar gutter and 24 pt panel padding; wrap all help to available width. Put 13 pt labels above each dropdown with 6 pt label/control and 16 pt row gaps.

top_issues.issue: Shortcut notation is inconsistent across the screenshots.
top_issues.evidence: Shortcuts overlay says Ctrl K and Ctrl R; empty-chat states show Command-K and settings show Command-R. This is a visible cross-screen inconsistency, independent of actual keyboard behavior.
top_issues.fix: Use one platform-specific shortcut formatter throughout. Show Ctrl on Windows/Linux and Command glyphs on macOS; use matching 12 pt keycaps and add a 24 pt close control to the shortcuts dialog.

top_issues.issue: Tall draft lacks a visible internal scroll cue and convenient action alignment.
top_issues.evidence: Composer extends y551-765 with a partially cut line at its top. Attach and Send remain around y657, centered vertically rather than near the final line.
top_issues.fix: Keep the 200 pt draft height cap, add a visible 6 pt internal scrollbar and 8 pt vertical padding; bottom-align 28x28 pt attach/send buttons with 12 pt bottom inset.

top_issues.issue: Call status and completion action are ambiguous.
top_issues.evidence: Top reads In the meeting and just joined; visible history says Meeting ended. Top Done button is presented with a checkmark and no explanation of whether it ends or leaves the call.
top_issues.fix: Label the action Close call panel if that is its function. Place historical meeting events in a 12 pt dated separator and label active status Current call in 13 pt text; keep an 8 pt gap between status and actions.

top_issues.issue: Calling page gives excessive explanation before a compact primary task.
top_issues.evidence: 1280 screenshot: introductory paragraph spans y109-154, capability table y330-530; join input is a single short row at y227. License and billing language occupies multiple table lines.
top_issues.fix: Lead with the 18 pt Join a meeting title and 32 pt-high input/button. Follow with one 14 pt line explaining that calls open in Teams; move the detailed capability text under a collapsed Calling limitations disclosure.

top_issues.issue: Positive status text fails body-text contrast.
top_issues.evidence: Works label sampled at x652-694,y336-350: #1F8F4C on #FFFFFF = 4.12:1. The labels are small text.
top_issues.fix: Use #15803D for light positive-status text, yielding 5.02:1, and add a 16 pt check icon so the status also has a shape cue.

top_issues.issue: Message actions drift far from their content in wide windows.
top_issues.evidence: 1920 screenshot: conversation text begins x432; hovered reaction toolbar is x1660-1899 around y478, while the corresponding message is near the left margin.
top_issues.fix: Cap readable message column at 840 pt and place hover actions within 16 pt of that column edge; keep composer aligned to the same reading column.

top_issues.issue: Onboarding footers are faint, long lines and secondary actions have inconsistent emphasis.
top_issues.evidence: Privacy line spans approximately x212-1069, rendered #8C8E96/#F6F6F7 = 3.03:1 in light and #6D6F78/#1D1E22 = 3.33:1 in dark. Browser waiting screen has three equally styled buttons.
top_issues.fix: Wrap footer to a 560 pt column at 12 pt using accessible secondary colors. In browser waiting state make Open the page again primary, Copy link secondary and Cancel tertiary; keep 8 pt action gaps.

top_issues.issue: Secondary identity and keyboard help are too small for dependable scanning.
top_issues.evidence: New-chat emails are about 13 px high; account emails about 11 px; search footer x354-925,y604-631 wraps instructions across two lines. Muted contrast compounds the small scale.
top_issues.fix: Use 13 pt emails and 12 pt help text with 16 pt line height. Give search keyboard help a separate 32 pt footer; use 2 pt accent selection indicators alongside selected-row fill.
